authors.name: Sarah Mitchell
authors.bio: Sarah covers California driver licensing, vehicle registration, and DMV procedures. She's been writing about transportation topics for over a decade and is committed to making bureaucratic processes easy for everyday drivers.

authors.name: Michael Anderson
authors.bio: Michael is a former driving instructor with 15+ years of experience preparing first-time drivers for the California DMV permit and behind-the-wheel tests. His articles focus on test-taking strategy and real-world driving skills.

authors.name: Lisa Thompson
authors.bio: Lisa breaks down California's auto insurance requirements, financial responsibility laws, and SR-1 procedures. She helps drivers understand the rules without the legalese.

authors.name: Jennifer Rodriguez
authors.bio: Jennifer reports on new California traffic legislation, DMV policy changes, and rule updates that affect everyday drivers. She tracks bills from Sacramento and translates them into plain English.

authors.name: Robert Johnson
authors.bio: Robert helps drivers navigate the online and in-person DMV experience — appointments, kiosks, REAL ID, and renewal services. He's spent years cataloging every shortcut around long DMV wait times.

authors.name: David Chen
authors.bio: David covers defensive driving, road conditions, and California-specific safety topics — from Santa Ana winds to mountain driving. He pulls from CHP reports and DMV safety data.

authors.name: Jennifer Lee
authors.bio: Jennifer specializes in driver's ed curriculum, teen driver requirements, and provisional licensing. She helps parents and new drivers understand California's graduated licensing system.

authors.name: Michael Rodriguez
authors.bio: Michael covers California vehicle registration, smog checks, transfer of ownership, and out-of-state vehicle imports. He demystifies the DMV's vehicle paperwork.

authors.name: Thomas Anderson
authors.bio: Thomas writes about California Class M motorcycle endorsements and Class A/B commercial driver licenses. Former DMV examiner with a focus on test prep and licensing pathways.
